about: L4 avatar goldens (the test strategy, sections 3.1 and 3.3), rendered by the exported viewer's --test-render (tools/render.ps1, the avatars cases). Every one is local-only: the avatar body is read in place from a character folder named by NV_CHARACTER_DIR (the official viewer's character files, never committed, copied or shipped), and the baked images are a test account's own server bakes, so the goldens live in fixtures-local/goldens and are never committed; the render stage skips with a reason when the character folder is not set. Goldens are proposed by the render script and approved by a person after viewing; each entry's sha256 is the approved image's.
